snippet.title: Untitled Sonic Fangame DEMO OUT NOW!!!!
snippet.description:
DOWNLOAD NOW: https://gamejolt.com/games/UntitledSonicFangame/879424

Untitled Sonic Fangame is a project of mine that i've been working on since the beginning of 2022, and i'm happy to announce that I finally have a fully working demo to release to the public! please let me know if you find any glitches or if you have any criticism to offer ^-^

my plan is to eventually reskin all of the sprites and textures to make this into its own independent game, with a brand new protagonist and a brand new villain... stay tuned for future updates 8)
